interpretation.missingness_rule: Threshold flags use observed denominators; any required-group infrastructure missingness prevents an unconditional conclusion.
interpretation.nonsignificance_rule: A nonsignificant effect is not evidence that the agent ignores scope.
interpretation.recognition_action_gap_scope: Descriptive conditional association; separate readback branches do not establish that recognition caused the decision.

inline.invalid_convention: Observed invalid/refused decisions contribute zero to each inspection indicator; also report invalid-excluded sensitivity.
